Name: FreeCraftMod
Author: TwilightTide
Description:
[size=4][b]描述[/b][/size]
This mod allows you to toggle free crafting and cooking mode by pressing F9. When enabled, crafting and cooking recipes no longer consume any materials. Press F9 again to switch back to vanilla mode.

[size=4][b]安装说明[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI
2. Drop the FreeCraftMod folder into your Mods folder
